geometry.note: 'other', not 'hall', because this OSM area is tagged 'source: extrapolation ... cadastre ... mise à jour 2015' (extrapolated from French cadastral parcel data, not a surveyed hall footprint), and no fetched source gives the actual hall/gallery dimensions positioned in space (only the undifferentiated totals in src:geo-euro-ug-pandola-2011: a 30x10x11 m Main Hall, a 70 m2 Gamma Spectrometry Hall, and two secondary halls of 18 and 21 m2). 'approximate' rather than 'verified': OpenStreetMap alone is rank 11.

method: OpenStreetMap way 235115147 (office=research, name='Laboratoire souterrain de Modane', addr:housename='PK 6.5, Tunnel du Fréjus'), taken verbatim. Independently cross-checked (not a formal checks[] row, no external official figure to test against) by walking geometry:modane-tunnel-frejus's own line to its geometric midpoint (6431 m from the Modane portal, of a 12 862 m total): the two positions are 148 m apart, consistent with both the OSM way's own 'PK 6.5' (kilometre 6.5) address tag and with src:geo-modane-cnrs-images-shelter6's qualitative claim that the laboratory sits 'exactement au centre' of the tunnel.
name: Laboratoire Souterrain de Modane (underground laboratory)
notes: This is the underground laboratory itself (inside the mountain), not the Carré Science surface outreach building in Modane village (see geometry:modane-carre-sciences-point) which the pre-existing site:lsm-frejus coordinate (an OSM/Nominatim point 6.4 km away, precision_m 500) actually reflects; see the facility worklog for a proposed site coordinate correction.

summary.plain: The Modane underground laboratory itself, roughly at the midpoint of the Fréjus road tunnel between France and Italy, under about 1700 m of rock.
